guardSemantics.seedM: the audited rule-level M of the historical QAOPL base seed
guardSemantics.deltaD: number of shengjie first-component families moved relative to that seed
guardSemantics.deltaV: number of rhyme-body families shifted relative to that seed
guardSemantics.MGuard: seedM + deltaD + deltaV; a conservative search guard, not a final exact M audit
